new_value: Implemented (commit this round): lichen_announce_get_pinned_pubkey(originator_iid, out_pubkey[32]) — read-only accessor over the announce TOFU pin table for the DAO Origin Signature verification key (spec 05 8.6: key from an already-pinned identity; a DAO must not create/replace a pin). Lock discipline: ingest_mutex -> announce_mutex (matches lichen_announce_reset's documented order), memcpy under both locks, NULL guards fail closed without writing. Host test test_get_pinned_pubkey_returns_pinned_identity (native_sim): ingest pins seed_a's identity, accessor returns the pubkey matching the announce wire bytes at offset 5+LICHEN_ANNOUNCE_IID_LEN; unknown IID returns false. routing_announce native_sim suite 10/10 (was 9). Reviews: 3 passes on kimi-k3, all PASS (lock hierarchy, no pin mutation path, NULL guards, wire offsets verified; one P4 note on the test comment's no-write claim — the zeroed-buffer assert covers the practical property).
